title: NAVGit repository configuration (navgit.json)
description: Per-repository configuration for NAVGit. Supports Dynamics NAV 2016 (9.0) through Business Central 14 (C/AL).

projectName.description: Project name. Used for the default container name and the backup folder search.

containerName.description: Docker container name (max 15 characters, letters, digits and '-'). Default: projectName with '_' replaced by '-', truncated to 15 characters.

navRelease.description: Overrides the release name used in backup file names (default: 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019 for BC13, BC14 for BC14).

artifact.description: Which Docker artifact to use. Use exactly one form: an explicit url, a NAV release (nav + optional cu), or a version prefix.

cu.description: Cumulative update, e.g. rtm or cu30. Default: latest.

country.description: Localization, e.g. w1, no, dk. Default: w1.

type.description: Artifact type. Only OnPrem is meaningful for C/AL.

version.description: Version prefix between 9 and 14, e.g. 14, 14.0 or 14.0.29537.0 (resolved with Get-BcArtifactUrl).

country.description: Localization, e.g. w1, no, dk. Default: w1.

select.description: Which matching artifact to pick. Closest requires a full four-part version. Default: Latest.

imageName.description: Local image name used by BcContainerHelper. Combined with a backup file this builds a cached image without the Cronus database (-nodb).

database.description: Which database the container starts with.

bakFile.description: Backup file: absolute path, path relative to the repository or the user backupFolder, or an http(s) URL. Passed to New-BcContainer -bakFile.

useDemo.description: Use the Cronus demo database from the artifact instead of a backup.

searchNames.description: Extra names to try (after projectName) when searching the user backupFolder.

licenseFile.description: License file: absolute path, path relative to the repository or the user licenseFolder, or an http(s) URL. '{major}' is replaced with the major version.

auth.description: Container authentication. Default: user setting defaultAuth, otherwise NavUserPassword on Azure AD joined machines and Windows elsewhere.

isolation.description: Container isolation (New-BcContainer -isolation). Empty lets BcContainerHelper choose. Default: user setting defaultIsolation, otherwise empty.

memoryLimit.description: Container memory limit, e.g. 8G. Empty uses the BcContainerHelper default (8G for hyperv).

dns.description: DNS server for the container, or 'hostDNS'. Empty uses the Docker default.

updateHosts.description: Add the container to the hosts file so it can be reached by name.

enableSymbolLoading.description: Enable symbol loading (NAV 2018 / BC14 only, versions 11-14).

includeTestToolkit.description: Import the test toolkit while creating the container.

myScripts.description: Scripts passed to New-BcContainer -myScripts (URLs or paths).

additionalParameters.description: Extra docker run parameters. Settings that have their own entry (bakfile, licensefile, credentials, database, artifactUrl) are rejected here.

objects.description: Folder (relative to the repository) for application objects.

tests.description: Folder (relative to the repository) for test objects.

addIns.description: Folder (relative to the repository) with .NET add-ins. When it exists it is mapped to c:\run\Add-ins in the container and copied to the service tier and Windows client Add-ins folders. Empty disables it.

testObjects.description: How exported objects are recognised as test objects.

versionListPattern.description: Case-insensitive regular expression matched against the Version List.

includeTestCodeunits.description: Also treat codeunits with Subtype=Test as test objects.

deleteMissing.description: Objects in the database but not in Git (usually outside the license range): 'skip' only writes a count to the verbose output, 'warn' lists them, 'mark' sets their Version List to #DELETE and lists them. A deleteMissing in the user settings overrides this.

syncSchema.description: SynchronizeSchemaChanges used for import and compile.

compileFilter.description: C/SIDE filter for objects compiled after import.

dateFormat.description: Format of Date in the object files, e.g. 'dd.MM.yy' or 'MM/dd/yy'. Empty: derived from the separator ('.' dd.MM.yy, '-' dd-MM-yy, '/' MM/dd/yy). Only used to detect changed objects.

filter.description: C/SIDE filter for objects exported to Git, e.g. 'Type=Table;Id=50000..50099'. Empty exports all objects (as AdvaniaGIT did); only then are object files of deleted objects removed from Git.

defaultProfile.description: Profile ID used by 'Start NAV Client (default)'. Empty opens the default role center.

showBcContainerCommand.description: Write the full New-BcContainer command (credential hidden) to the output before a container is built. Default: user setting showBcContainerCommand, otherwise false.
